newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets reverses at 2.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets reverses at 2.75 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Canada conducted a round of reverse repurchase agreements at 2.75 percent in the money market, dealers said.
They said the operation confirmed the central bank's target range for Canada's overnight rate at 2.75 percent to 3.25 percent.
After the intervention Canadian T-bill yields were slightly lower than Thursday's close and the overnight rate had edged against the floor target of 2.75 percent.
Canada's three-month when-issued T-bill yield was down three basis points from Thursday's close at 2.84 percent.
